parameters.label: CHM Raster

parameters.label: Line Processing Radius
parameters.description: Maximum processing distance from input lines. A large search radius may increase processing times whereas a small radius may cause undesired clipping.

parameters.label: CHM Mode
parameters.description: CHM preprocessing mode. 'current' uses existing raster clipping; 'alt' applies local-maxima filtering; 'buffer' reduces raw CHM values around the input line before initial path generation.

parameters.description: Distance from the input line where raw CHM values are reduced before initial path generation.

parameters.label: CHM Buffer Multiplier
parameters.description: Multiplier applied to valid raw CHM values inside the input-line buffer.

parameters.label: Process Segments
parameters.description: Process each segment between vertices separately

parameters.label: Centerline Method

parameters.label: Guided Strategy

parameters.label: Simplify LCP
parameters.description: Run geo-simplify reduce-bend on the least-cost path before corridor generation.

parameters.label: LCP Simplify Diameter (m)
parameters.description: Diameter used by reduce-bend for the least-cost path before corridor generation.

parameters.label: Smooth LCP

parameters.label: LCP Smooth Iterations

parameters.label: A* Corridor Line Bias
parameters.description: Tie-breaking weight that biases A* accumulation toward the endpoint direction.

parameters.label: A* Corridor Distance Penalty
parameters.description: Penalty applied by distance from the A* path when building the A* accumulation corridor.

parameters.label: Simplify Corridor Polygon
parameters.description: Simplify the corridor polygon before extracting the final centerline.

parameters.label: Corridor Simplify Length (m)
parameters.description: Topology-preserving simplification tolerance for the corridor polygon.

parameters.label: Smooth Corridor Polygon
parameters.description: Apply Chaikin smoothing to the corridor polygon before centerline extraction.

parameters.label: Corridor Smooth Iterations
parameters.description: Number of Chaikin smoothing iterations for the corridor polygon.

parameters.label: Simplify Centerline
parameters.description: Run geo-simplify reduce-bend on extracted centerlines.

parameters.label: Simplify Diameter (m)
parameters.description: Diameter used by simplify reduce-bend. Uses layer CRS units (meters in projected CRS).

tools.name: Canopy Footprint (Relative Threshold)
tools.info: Creates dynamic footprint polygons for each input line based on a least cost corridor method and individual line canopy thresholds and cost raster.

parameters.label: Centerline
parameters.description: Input line file.

parameters.label: CHM Raster
parameters.description: Input raster image used calculate the surrounding forest elevation percentile, create canopy and cost raster.

parameters.label: Maximum Line Width
parameters.description: Maximum processing width for input lines. A large value may increase processing times whereas a small value may cause undesired clipping.

parameters.label: Expand And Shrink Cell Range
parameters.description: Range used for cell erosion before final polygons are generated. Useful to remove small artifacts.  If the cell size is 1m or larger then set this as zero.

parameters.label: Output Footprint
parameters.description: Output footprint polygons.

parameters.label: Output Centerline
parameters.description: Output centerline polygons.

parameters.label: Offset Line Distance
parameters.description: Offset distance from input lines.

parameters.label: Canopy Percentile
parameters.description: The Nth percentile of the surrounding forest.

parameters.label: Canopy Threshold Percentage
parameters.description: Apply % on calculating Canopy Threshold height from Canopy percentile elevation.

parameters.label: Tree Search Radius
parameters.description: Radius of canopy influence in the cost raster. This factor smooths the canopy in the cost raster which helps to prevent gaps in sparsely vegetated areas (e.g. wetlands) to be incorrectly identified as footprint. A large search radius (>=5m) may cause excessive smoothing of the cost raster which can lead to least cost paths ignoring forest-line nuances in sparsely vegetated forests. A small radius (<=1m) may cause the least cost path to cut corners through small gaps in sparse vegetation as well as avoid small obstacles that should not affect overall line shape.

parameters.label: Maximum Line Distance
parameters.description: Maximum euclidean distance from canopy. This is a second smoothing factor which helps to position the forest line shape in the center of the line footprint. An excessively small (<=1m) or large (>20m) value may cause the center line to be positioned close to one of the edges of the footprint.

parameters.label: Canopy Avoidance
parameters.description: Ratio of importance between canopy search radius and euclidean distance. A value close to zero (0) prioritizes search radius whereas a value close to one (1) prioritizes euclidean distance. A small value (<=0.1) may cause the forest lines to miss nuances in sparsely vegetated terrain whereas a big value (>=0.5) may overemphasize turns in complex trails. This factor influences final footprint size in a minor way.

parameters.label: Cost Raster Exponent
parameters.description: Affects the cost of vegetated areas in an exponential fashion. A low (<=1) exponent may lead to lines cutting through corners, whereas a large (>=3) exponent may lead to least cost paths completely avoiding narrow lines.

parameters.label: Centerline
parameters.description: Input centerline file.

parameters.label: Input Footprint
parameters.description: Input footprint.

parameters.label: Sampling number
parameters.description: Sampling number for each line.

parameters.label: Perpendicular line length (m)
parameters.description: The length of the perpendicular line in meters. Internally converted to layer CRS units.

parameters.label: Use maximum width
parameters.description: Use maximum sampled width for footprint.

parameters.label: Output Ground Footprint
parameters.description: Output fixed width ground footprint file.

tools.name: Footprint Plots and Subplots
tools.info: Split line footprints into plots and subplots along their centerlines, with plot, side and subplot IDs.

parameters.label: Input Footprint
parameters.description: Input line footprint polygons.

parameters.label: Input Centerline
parameters.description: Centerlines of the footprints. Each footprint uses the centerline with the longest overlap.

parameters.label: Segmentation mode
parameters.description: 'fixed_area' cuts plots and subplots to a target area. 'fixed_length' cuts them at a fixed spacing along the centerline.

parameters.label: Plot area (m2)
parameters.description: Fixed area mode: target plot area covering both sides of the line. Each side of a plot is a separate feature.

parameters.label: Subplot area (m2)
parameters.description: Fixed area mode: target subplot area on one side of the line. Subplots nest inside plots, so plot area / (2 x subplot area) is rounded to whole subplots.

parameters.label: Plot length (m)
parameters.description: Fixed length mode: distance between plot boundaries along the centerline.

parameters.label: Subplot length (m)
parameters.description: Fixed length mode: distance between subplot boundaries along the centerline. Subplots restart at each plot boundary.

parameters.label: Remove overlaps
parameters.description: Cut overlaps between footprints, such as at line crossings, so each area is in only one plot and subplot and is not counted twice. A line ending in an overlap always loses it and is trimmed back. At crossings, north-south and east-west lines keep the overlap over lines in other directions, then the longer centerline.

parameters.label: Output Plots
parameters.description: Output plot polygons, one feature per plot side.

parameters.label: Output Subplots
parameters.description: Output subplot polygons.

tools.name: Surface Water Mapping
tools.info: Map surface water from a true-colour orthomosaic: an rpart decision tree trained on random points in labelled polygons, an optional canopy height mask and removal of small water patches (Chan, Dabros & McDermid 2026, Forests 17, 489).

parameters.label: Orthomosaic raster
parameters.description: True-colour orthomosaic; bands 1-3 are read as red, green and blue.

parameters.label: Training polygons
parameters.description: Polygons with a 'class' field: 'water' for surface water and other labels (e.g. 'ground', 'shadow') for everything else.

parameters.label: Output folder
parameters.description: Folder for surface_water.tif (1 water, 0 not water) and the cross-validation tables.

parameters.label: Canopy height model
parameters.description: Optional CHM; cells with canopy taller than the maximum canopy height cannot be water.

parameters.label: Maximum canopy height
parameters.description: Cells with CHM above this height (m) are not water. Used only with a CHM.

parameters.label: Minimum water patch area
parameters.description: Water patches smaller than this area (m2) are removed. 0 keeps every patch.

parameters.label: Training points per polygon
parameters.description: Number of random training points drawn inside each training polygon.

parameters.label: Random seed
parameters.description: Seed for the random training points and cross-validation folds.

parameters.label: Tile size (cells)
parameters.description: The orthomosaic is classified in square tiles of this many cells per side, in parallel; smaller tiles use less memory per worker.

tools.name: Depth-to-Water from Surface Water
tools.info: Krige a water table from the minimum surface water elevation in each grid cell, then compute depth-to-water as DTM minus water table, 0 on surface water (Chan, Dabros & McDermid 2026, Forests 17, 489; Rahman et al. 2017).

parameters.label: DTM raster
parameters.description: Digital terrain model, e.g. from Generate DTM from LiDAR Data. The water table and DTW are produced on its grid.

parameters.label: Surface water raster
parameters.description: Raster with 1 for surface water, e.g. surface_water.tif from Surface Water Mapping. Resampled to the DTM grid if needed.

parameters.label: Output folder
parameters.description: Folder for water_table.tif, dtw.tif and the variogram and cross-validation outputs.

parameters.label: Exclusion polygons
parameters.description: Optional polygons to leave out (e.g. uplands with too little surface water); they get no water points and NA in the outputs.

parameters.label: Water point grid size
parameters.description: Size (m) of the grid cells; the minimum water elevation in each cell becomes one kriging point.

parameters.label: Nearest observations
parameters.description: Number of nearest water points used for each kriging prediction.

parameters.label: Variogram model
parameters.description: gstat variogram model: Ste (Matern, M. Stein's parameterization), Sph (spherical), Exp (exponential) or Gau (Gaussian).

parameters.label: Kriging cell size
parameters.description: Cell size (m) for kriging; the result is resampled bilinearly to the DTM. 0 kriges on the DTM grid itself, which is slow for large fine DTMs.

parameters.label: Tile size (cells)
parameters.description: The kriging grid is kriged in square tiles of this many cells per side, in parallel; smaller tiles use less memory per worker.

tools.name: Seismic Line Disturbance Analysis
tools.info: Compare seismic line segments with the adjacent undisturbed matrix by disturbance class: elevation, hummock cover, depth-to-water and surface water deviations, with Kruskal-Wallis, pairwise Wilcoxon and Brown-Forsythe tests (Chan, Dabros & McDermid 2026, Forests 17, 489).

parameters.label: Segment polygons
parameters.description: Seismic line and matrix segment polygons with fields new_id (links a line segment to its matrix segments), note ('original' for line, 'matrix' for matrix) and Class (disturbance class).

parameters.label: DTM raster
parameters.description: Digital terrain model, e.g. from Generate DTM from LiDAR Data.

parameters.label: Microform raster
parameters.description: Hummock (1), lawn (0) and hollow (-1) raster, e.g. the HH_ output of Detect Hummock and Hollow from LiDAR Data.

parameters.label: Output folder
parameters.description: Folder for the output tables (CSV) and plots (PNG).

parameters.label: Depth-to-water raster
parameters.description: Depth-to-water raster in metres, with 0 marking surface water. Leave empty to skip the depth-to-water and surface water analyses.

parameters.label: Significance level
parameters.description: Significance level for the letter groupings of the pairwise tests.

parameters.label: Input Feature Class
parameters.description: Input Feature Class.

parameters.label: Buffer Distance (m)
parameters.description: Set distance to generate buffer for input features.

parameters.label: Output Buffered Features
parameters.description: Output buffered features.
